pick.headline: Iran recaptures Khorramshahr
pick.fbis: The Middle East & South Asia review of May 24, 1982, reported IRNA claiming 30,000 Iraqi troops in Khorramshahr had surrendered and the city was near 'complete liberation', against an Iraqi communique claiming heavy Iranian losses.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Middle East & Africa, Vol. V No. 100, 24 May 1982
evidence.snippet: DAILY REPORT MIDDLE EAST AND SOUTH ASTA REVIEW 24 MAY 1982 Iran-Iraq Conflict Military Situation -- Thirty thousand Iraqi troops stationed in Khorramshahr have com- pletely surrendered, putting up very little resistance, IRNA reported on 24 May. alternates.headline: Operation Solomon airlifts Ethiopian Jews to Israel
alternates.fbis: The Near East & South Asia Daily Report of May 28, 1991, ran an Israel item headed "U.S. Praised for Assistance to Ethiopian Jews"; the OCR of its text is too garbled to read beyond scattered words about Addis Ababa and Ethiopia.
